column2: # Function: compute accident rates for each alert system with 0 or 1 active system
# Only include: no active system, or exactly one at a time
# Filter population: this alert system + exactly this active system (no extras)
# Filter accident cases, exclude extreme alert combos
# Extract baseline when no active system was added
p = ggplot(final_df, aes(x = ActiveAdded, y = RelativeChangeFromNone, color = Alert)) +
title = "Effect of Adding One Active System to Each Alert System",
subtitle = "Each point shows change in accident rate compared to alert-only baseline",
ggsave("Effect of Adding One Active System to Each Alert System.png", p, bg = "white", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
